angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 847,269 km at 15.53 pc = 0.73 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 64.4048 +/- 0.0771 mas (same row, RUWE 1.06): 15.53 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.218 (1.193 to 1.242) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 847,269 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.942 (0.902 to 0.982) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5663 +/- 1.3 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2835207319109249920: teff_gspphot 5662.524 K (16th-84th percentiles 5661.2275-5663.87), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2835207319109249920: teff_gspphot 5662.524 K (16th-84th percentiles 5661.2275-5663.87), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/helvetios.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.241, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of 51 Peg (pscomppars): spectral type G5V, from Turnbull 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015arXiv151001731T/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of 51 Peg (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.2058 dex, from Rosenthal et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021ApJS..255....8R/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of 51 Peg (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.13631, from Butler et al. 2006 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2006ApJ...646..505B/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of 51 Peg (pscomppars): age 10 Gyr, from Mayor & Queloz 1995 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1995Natur.378..355M/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of 51 Peg (pscomppars): rotation period 30 d, from Mayor & Queloz 1995 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1995Natur.378..355M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of 51 Peg (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.2 km/s, from Mayor & Queloz 1995 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1995Natur.378..355M/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
